$description: Badge V2 Component Contract. Non-interactive status marker with text and dot presentations.
compositionRules: Badge is a non-interactive status marker, not a Button, Tag or interactive control.
Kind controls whether the marker is text or dot; it does not create an interaction state.
Tone controls semantic color roles and does not represent a runtime lifecycle state.
Dot presentation does not render label content; text presentation renders the runtime label inside the container.
Badge has no hover, pressed, focused, disabled or loading axis.
Badge geometry is resolved from kind-specific visual tokens and content measurement; label text never becomes a design Token.
